{"tools":[
{"name":"list_suppliers","description":"Lists suppliers of beans, milk and cups, optionally filtered by product category or status. Use it to find a supplier ID or see who can supply a category.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"category":{"type":"string","enum":["beans","milk","cups"],"description":"Product category the supplier sells"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["active","paused","blocked"],"description":"Supplier status filter"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":25}},"required":[]},"request":"Which of our suppliers currently sell oat milk and are still active?"},
{"name":"get_supplier","description":"Returns the full profile of one supplier: contact person, payment terms, minimum order value, lead time and delivery days. Use it when you need the terms or contact details of a specific supplier.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"supplier_id":{"type":"string","description":"Supplier ID, e.g. SUP-0042"}},"required":["supplier_id"]},"request":"What are the payment terms and the minimum order value for Nordic Dairy Co?"},
{"name":"search_supplier_products","description":"Searches the supplier catalog for beans, milk or cups by keyword, category, supplier or pack size, and returns SKUs with current unit prices. Use it to find the SKU before creating a purchase order.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Free text such as 'single origin Ethiopia' or '12oz compostable'"},"category":{"type":"string","enum":["beans","milk","cups"]},"supplier_id":{"type":"string"},"max_unit_price":{"type":"number","description":"Maximum price per pack in the account currency"}},"required":["query"]},"request":"Find compostable 12oz hot cups in sleeves of 50 from any supplier under 15 euros per sleeve."},
{"name":"get_price_history","description":"Shows the historical purchase price of a SKU over time, including price changes by the supplier. Use it to check whether a supplier raised prices or to prepare a negotiation.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"from_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"to_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"required":["sku"]},"request":"How has the price of our 1kg house espresso blend, SKU BEAN-ESP-1KG, changed since January?"},
{"name":"create_purchase_order","description":"Creates a draft purchase order to a supplier with one or more SKU lines, quantities and a requested delivery date. The order is not sent until send_purchase_order is called.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"supplier_id":{"type":"string"},"lines":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"unit_price":{"type":"number","description":"Agreed price; defaults to catalog price"}},"required":["sku","quantity"]}},"requested_delivery_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"delivery_location_id":{"type":"string","description":"Shop or warehouse to deliver to"},"notes":{"type":"string"}},"required":["supplier_id","lines"]},"request":"Draft a purchase order to Nordic Dairy Co for 40 cartons of whole milk and 20 cartons of oat milk for delivery next Thursday to the Main Street shop."},
{"name":"get_purchase_order","description":"Retrieves one purchase order with its lines, status, totals, and linked deliveries and invoices. Use it to check the state of a specific PO.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"po_number":{"type":"string","description":"Purchase order number, e.g. PO-2024-0187"}},"required":["po_number"]},"request":"What's the status of PO-2024-0187, and has anything been delivered against it yet?"},
{"name":"list_purchase_orders","description":"Lists purchase orders filtered by supplier, status or date range. Use it to review open, late or recently placed orders.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"supplier_id":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["draft","sent","confirmed","partially_received","received","cancelled"]},"created_from":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"created_to":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":25}},"required":[]},"request":"Show me all purchase orders that were sent last week but not yet confirmed by the supplier."},
{"name":"update_purchase_order","description":"Changes a draft or unconfirmed purchase order: add, remove or change line quantities, the delivery date or notes. Use it when the order needs adjusting before the supplier ships.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"po_number":{"type":"string"},"line_changes":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"action":{"type":"string","enum":["add","set_quantity","remove"]},"quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":0}},"required":["sku","action"]}},"requested_delivery_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"notes":{"type":"string"}},"required":["po_number"]},"request":"On PO-2024-0192 change the quantity of Brazilian beans from 10 bags to 25 bags."},
{"name":"send_purchase_order","description":"Sends a draft purchase order to the supplier by email or EDI and marks it as sent. Use it after the draft has been reviewed.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"po_number":{"type":"string"},"channel":{"type":"string","enum":["email","edi","portal"],"default":"email"},"message":{"type":"string","description":"Optional cover note to the supplier"}},"required":["po_number"]},"request":"The draft PO-2024-0195 looks right, please send it to the supplier by email."},
{"name":"cancel_purchase_order","description":"Cancels a purchase order that has not been fully delivered and records a reason. Use it when the order is no longer needed or the supplier cannot fulfil it.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"po_number":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string","enum":["no_longer_needed","supplier_cannot_fulfil","duplicate","price_change","other"]},"comment":{"type":"string"},"notify_supplier":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["po_number","reason"]},"request":"Cancel PO-2024-0190, I accidentally ordered cups twice and it's a duplicate."},
{"name":"list_expected_deliveries","description":"Lists upcoming and overdue supplier deliveries with expected dates, time windows and destination shops. Use it to plan receiving or chase late shipments.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"from_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"to_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"location_id":{"type":"string"},"supplier_id":{"type":"string"},"overdue_only":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"required":[]},"request":"What deliveries are due at the Harbor Street shop tomorrow and the day after?"},
{"name":"get_delivery","description":"Returns details of a single delivery: carrier, tracking number, expected and actual arrival, items and receipt status. Use it to track one shipment.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"delivery_id":{"type":"string","description":"Delivery ID, e.g. DLV-88213"}},"required":["delivery_id"]},"request":"Where is delivery DLV-88213 right now and what's the tracking number?"},
{"name":"record_delivery_receipt","description":"Records goods received for a delivery, with the quantity actually received per line, and updates stock and the purchase order status. Use it when a delivery arrives at the shop.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"delivery_id":{"type":"string"},"received_lines":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"quantity_received":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},"lot_number":{"type":"string"},"best_before":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"required":["sku","quantity_received"]}},"received_by":{"type":"string"},"received_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"}},"required":["delivery_id","received_lines"]},"request":"Delivery DLV-88213 just arrived: we got all 20 bags of Colombian beans but only 30 of the 40 milk cartons."},
{"name":"report_delivery_issue","description":"Logs a problem with a delivery such as damaged goods, short shipment, wrong item or expired milk, with optional photos. Use it to document the issue and notify the supplier.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"delivery_id":{"type":"string"},"issue_type":{"type":"string","enum":["damaged","short_shipment","wrong_item","expired_or_short_dated","late","other"]},"sku":{"type":"string"},"affected_quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"description":{"type":"string"},"photo_urls":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","format":"uri"}}},"required":["delivery_id","issue_type","description"]},"request":"Log a problem on DLV-88230: six cartons of oat milk arrived leaking and unusable."},
{"name":"list_invoices","description":"Lists supplier invoices filtered by supplier, payment status or due date. Use it to see what is unpaid, overdue or due soon.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"supplier_id":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["received","matched","disputed","approved","paid","overdue"]},"due_before":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":25}},"required":[]},"request":"Which supplier invoices are overdue or due before the end of this month?"},
{"name":"get_invoice","description":"Returns one supplier invoice with line items, taxes, totals, due date, and the linked PO and delivery. Use it to inspect a specific invoice.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_number":{"type":"string","description":"Supplier's invoice number"},"supplier_id":{"type":"string","description":"Needed if the invoice number is not unique across suppliers"}},"required":["invoice_number"]},"request":"Open invoice INV-55120 and show me the line items and the total including VAT."},
{"name":"match_invoice_to_delivery","description":"Runs a three-way match between a supplier invoice, its purchase order and the recorded delivery receipts, and reports quantity and price discrepancies. Use it before approving an invoice for payment.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_number":{"type":"string"},"po_number":{"type":"string","description":"Optional; inferred from the invoice if omitted"},"price_tolerance_percent":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"default":2}},"required":["invoice_number"]},"request":"Check whether invoice INV-55120 matches what we ordered and actually received."},
{"name":"record_invoice_payment","description":"Records that a supplier invoice has been paid or schedules its payment, with amount, date and payment method. Use it after the invoice has been matched and approved.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_number":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0},"payment_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"method":{"type":"string","enum":["bank_transfer","card","direct_debit","cheque"]},"reference":{"type":"string","description":"Bank or transaction reference"}},"required":["invoice_number","amount","payment_date","method"]},"request":"Mark invoice INV-55087 as paid in full by bank transfer today, reference TRX-20931."},
{"name":"request_supplier_credit","description":"Requests a credit note or refund from a supplier for returned, damaged or overcharged goods, linked to an invoice or delivery. Use it when we are owed money back by the supplier.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_number":{"type":"string"},"delivery_id":{"type":"string"},"lines":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"unit_credit":{"type":"number"}},"required":["sku","quantity"]}},"reason":{"type":"string","enum":["damaged","short_shipment","overcharge","wrong_item","quality","other"]},"resolution":{"type":"string","enum":["credit_note","refund","replacement"],"default":"credit_note"},"comment":{"type":"string"}},"required":["invoice_number","reason"]},"request":"Ask the supplier for a credit note on invoice INV-55120 because we were charged for 10 milk cartons but only received 30 of 40."},
{"name":"get_supplier_spend_report","description":"Produces a report of purchasing spend by supplier, category (beans, milk, cups) or month over a date range, including order counts and on-time delivery rate. Use it for cost reviews and budgeting.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"from_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"to_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"group_by":{"type":"string","enum":["supplier","category","month","location"],"default":"supplier"},"supplier_id":{"type":"string"},"category":{"type":"string","enum":["beans","milk","cups"]}},"required":["from_date","to_date"]},"request":"Give me a report of how much we spent on each supplier in the last quarter, with their on-time delivery rates."}
]}
